name: dust_positions
description: Threat T22 (dust positions) made quantitative. A small position (40 USD of ETH collateral, so 30 USD of debt at the max-LTV limit) and a liquidator that only acts when the debt is worth at least 25 USD (a stand-in for the gas cost of a liquidation call). The first liquidation repays up to the close factor and can leave a residual debt below the threshold that nobody will ever liquidate. How often does that happen, and how often is such a stuck position also insolvent (debt worth more than its collateral)? The protocol has no minimum borrow size in v1, which is why this is documented as not mitigated.
